newsitem.title: USA: Fed changes FOMC minutes release time.
newsitem.headline: Fed changes FOMC minutes release time.

text.p: The Federal Reserve announced on Wednesday that it was changing the publication time for minutes of Federal Open Market Committee meetings to Thursday at 1400EST (1800 GMT).

The minutes have previously been issued for publication on Friday at 1630EST (2130 GMT). The new release time is permanent and is effective on Thursday, Feb 6, when minutes from the FOMC session held on Dec 17 will be issued.

The Fed issues minutes of FOMC meetings about six weeks after they occur, shortly after the subsequent meeting. The FOMC concluded a two-day meeting on Wednesday without announcing any change in interest-rate policy.

The Fed said its decision to change the release time on FOMC minutes reflected its desire "to be more forthcoming." It also said it wanted U.S. markets to be able to react first to the minutes, "if, indeed, there is any reaction."
